reasoning.evidence: Claude 3.5 Haiku provides fast, lightweight reasoning for high-throughput tasks.

coding.evidence: Good performance on lightweight coding, script generation, and syntax fixes.

architectureDesign.evidence: Suitable for simple modular scripts; complex multi-file architecture is better handled by Sonnet.

largeCodebaseUnderstanding.evidence: 200k context window supported; lightweight attention recall.

autocomplete.evidence: No native IDE autocomplete client extensions.

aiAgent.evidence: Fast execution for simple tool calls and web artifacts.

multiFileEditing.evidence: No native multi-file editing outside of chat uploads.

terminalIntegration.evidence: Lacks direct client command line terminal attachments.

planning.evidence: Fast lightweight planning for straightforward tasks.

research.evidence: Quick document summarization and text parsing.

writing.evidence: Fast prose generation, editing, and content formatting.

longContext.evidence: Supports 200k tokens context window at ultra-fast speeds.

imageUnderstanding.evidence: Basic image support; visual parsing is secondary to text throughput.

vision.evidence: Text-focused model; limited visual parsing compared to Sonnet.

voice.evidence: Supports speech-to-text input, but no low-latency real-time voice mode.

memory.evidence: Claude Projects features custom instructions and knowledge bases.

customGpts.evidence: No generic community GPT store integration.

plugins.evidence: Integration support for Slack, Google Drive, and Notion.

api.evidence: No client-facing developer token API built into web chat subscription.

embeddings.evidence: Internal search indices for workspace document vector storage.

functionCalling.evidence: Executes logic in Claude Artifacts and web components.

enterpriseSecurity.evidence: SOC2 certified, user data is not trained on.

adminControls.evidence: Claude Team console offers administration console controls.

ideIntegration.evidence: Third-party plugins, no official native IDE app.

githubIntegration.evidence: Allows sync with GitHub files inside chat workspace.

googleWorkspaceIntegration.evidence: Integrates with Google Drive files for easy analysis.

latency.evidence: Optimized output speeds on Sonnet and Haiku.

reliability.evidence: Good stability, rate limits are strict during peak hours.
